questions.question: In the figure, line p is parallel to line q, and line t intersects both lines. What is the value of x + 142?
questions.explanation: The angles x° and 142° together form a straight angle on line q, so x + 142 = 180.

questions.question:
b − 57 = (x)/(y)
The given equation relates the positive numbers b, x, and y. Which equation correctly expresses x in terms of b and y?
questions.explanation: Multiply both sides by y: x = y(b − 57) = by − 57y.

questions.question:
ak = b11(14 + m)
The given equation relates the positive variables a, b, k, and m. Which equation correctly expresses m in terms of a, b, and k?
questions.explanation: Multiply both sides by 11/b: 14 + m = 11ak/b, so m = 11ak/b − 14.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = x + 165, and f(a) = −19, where a is a constant. What is the value of a?
If x + 1 = 3, what is the value of 2(x + 1)?
questions.explanation: Substitute x + 1 = 3: 2(3) = 6.

questions.question: In the figure shown, line k intersects lines r and s. If w = 147, which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that lines r and s are parallel?
questions.explanation: Angles w and y are corresponding angles; if both equal 147° then lines r and s are parallel.

questions.question: What is an x-coordinate of an x-intercept of the graph of y = 4(x − 13)(x + 5)(x + 1) in the xy-plane?
questions.explanation: x-intercepts occur where y = 0: x = 13, −5 or −1; any one is acceptable.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to 158t<sup>3</sup> − 24t<sup>2u</sup>?
questions.explanation: Factor out 2t^2.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to 11(x<sup>2</sup> − 100y<sup>2</sup>)?
questions.explanation: Difference of squares: x^2 − 100y^2 = (x − 10y)(x + 10y).

questions.question: Which quadratic equation has no real solutions?
questions.explanation: For −2x^2 + 2x − 2 = 0 the discriminant is 4 − 16 = −12 < 0, so there are no real solutions. The others each have real solutions.

questions.question:
y = −14x2 + x + 28
The given equation models a company’s active projects over 6 months, where y is the estimated number of active projects x months after the end of April 2012, where 0 < x < 6. Which statement is the best interpretation of the y-intercept of the graph of this equation in the xy-plane?
options: At the end of April 2012, the estimated number of active projects was 0.
At the end of April 2012, the estimated number of active projects was 28.
At the end of May 2012, the estimated number of active projects was 0.
At the end of May 2012, the estimated number of active projects was 28.
questions.explanation: At x = 0 (the end of April 2012), y = 28.

can be rewritten as (4x + r)(3x + s), where r and s are integers, or as (4x + t)(3x + v), where t and v are not integers. What is the value of s + v?

y = f(x) − k

questions.question: A machine fills bags with approximately 11 ounces of sugar. To test the accuracy of the filling process, 132 bags of sugar were selected at random and weighed. Based on the sample, it is estimated that the average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine in an 8-hour period is 10.83 ounces, with an associated margin of error of 0.2 ounce. Which of the following is the best interpretation of this estimate?
options: Plausible values for the average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine are between 10.63 ounces and 11.03 ounces.
Plausible values for the average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine are less than 10.63 ounces or greater than 11.03 ounces.
The average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine is greater than 10.98 ounces.
The average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine is less than 10.98 ounces.
questions.explanation: 10.83 ± 0.2 gives the interval 10.63 to 11.03 ounces.

questions.question: Charles saves 35 of the $225 he earns each week from his summer job. If Charles continues to save at this rate, how much money, in dollars, will Charles save in 3 weeks?
questions.explanation: Each week he saves (3/5)(225) = 135 dollars, so in 3 weeks he saves 3 × 135 = 405 dollars.

questions.question: The histograms shown summarize two data sets, X and Y. Each data set consists of 25 whole numbers. In each histogram, the first interval represents the frequency of whole numbers greater than or equal to 70, but less than 75. The second interval represents the frequency of whole numbers greater than or equal to 75, but less than 80, and so on. What is the largest possible difference between the median of data set Y and the mean of data set X?

questions.question: The list gives the mass, in grams, of 5 ruffed lemurs. 3,810; 3,810; 3,030; 3,850; 3,050 What is the mean mass, in grams, of these 5 ruffed lemurs?

questions.question: Rectangles ABCD and EF GH are similar. The length of each side of EF GH is 10 times the length of the corresponding side of ABCD. The area of ABCD is 140 square units. What is the area, in square units, of EF GH?
The width of a rectangle is 16 inches less than 2 times its length, in inches. The area of the rectangle is 130 square inches. What is the width, in inches, of the rectangle?
questions.explanation: With length L, L(2L − 16) = 130 gives L^2 − 8L − 65 = 0, so L = 13 and the width is 2(13) − 16 = 10.

questions.question: A circle has center G, and points M and N lie on the circle. Line segments MH and NH are tangent to the circle at points M and N, respectively. If the radius of the circle is 168 millimeters and the perimeter of quadrilateral GMHN is 3,856 millimeters, what is the distance, in millimeters, between points G and H?

The floor of a school has an area of 2,025 square meters. An architect creates a scale model of the floor of the school, where the length of each side of the model is 1 15 times the length of the corresponding side of the actual floor of the school. What is the area, in square meters, of the scale model?
If 48 = 18 + 2(x − 9), what is the value of 2(x − 9)?
questions.explanation: Subtract 18 from both sides: 2(x − 9) = 30.

questions.question: Line p is defined by y = 6x − 8. Line s is parallel to line p in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line s?
questions.explanation: Parallel lines have equal slopes, so the slope of line s is 6.

questions.question:
9x + 5y = 19
−9x − 3y = 7
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of 2y?
questions.explanation: Adding the equations eliminates x: 2y = 26.

questions.question: Line k passes through the points (1,1) and (2,6) in the xy-plane. If the equation for the line k is written in the form y = mx + b, where m and b are constants, what is the value of m?

The graph shows the estimated concentration of a certain strain of bacteria, in millions of cells per mL of nutrient medium, over time x, in minutes since the initial measurement. According to the graph, which of the following is closest to the number of minutes it took for the estimated concentration of the bacteria to increase from 20 million cells per mL of nutrient medium to 30 million cells per mL of nutrient medium?
questions.explanation: The curve reaches 20 at about x = 34 minutes and 30 at about x = 50 minutes, a difference of about 16, which is closest to 15.

questions.question: A line segment that has a length of 113 centimeters (cm) is divided into three parts. One part is 47 cm long. The other two parts have lengths that are equal to each other. What is the length, in cm, of one of the other two parts of equal length?
questions.explanation: The other two parts total 113 − 47 = 66 cm, so each is 66 ÷ 2 = 33 cm.

questions.question: A linear model estimates the population of a city from 1992 to 2016. The model estimates the population was 51 thousand in 1992, 225 thousand in 2012, and x thousand in 2016. To the nearest whole number, what is the value of x?
questions.explanation: The rate is (225 − 51)/20 = 8.7 thousand per year, so x = 225 + 4(8.7) = 259.8 ≈ 260.

questions.question: The y-intercept of the graph of y = 2x<sup>2</sup> + 27 is (0, y). What is the value of y?
Which expression is equivalent to (3x<sup>3</sup> − 8x + 5) − (4x<sup>6</sup> + 9x − 2)?
questions.explanation: Distribute the negative: 3x³ − 8x + 5 − 4x⁶ − 9x + 2 = −4x⁶ + 3x³ − 17x + 7.

questions.question: For the polynomial function f, the graph of y = f(x) in the xy−plane passes through the points (−4, 0), (3, 0), and (5, 0). Which of the following must be a factor of f(x)?
questions.explanation: The graph crosses the x-axis at x = 3, so f(3) = 0 and x − 3 is a factor.

questions.question: The function f(x) = 5000(1.21)<sup>x/2</sup> models a value x years from now. Which equivalent form shows the yearly growth factor as the base?

The equation y = −4.9(x − 8.9)2 + 12,400 gives the estimated height above ground, y, in meters, of a plane, where x is the number of seconds since it started a parabolic maneuver. If this equation is graphed in the xy−plane, which of the following is the best interpretation of the vertex of the graph?
options: The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 12,400 meters 4.9 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 12,400 meters 8.9 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 4.9 meters 12,400 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
The plane reached an estimated maximum height of 8.9 meters 12,400 seconds after it started the parabolic maneuver.
questions.explanation: The vertex is (8.9, 12,400); since the coefficient is negative it is a maximum, 12,400 m at x = 8.9 s.

questions.question: To the nearest whole percent, the total number of residents who voted for Candidate 1 is what percent of the total number of residents who voted for Candidate 2?

On January 1, 2000, the population of a town was 26,252 and on January 1, 2010, the population was 26,753. The equation 10x + 26,252 = 26,753 describes this situation. Which of the following is the best interpretation of x in this context?
options: The percentage by which the population of the town increased each year between 2000 and 2010
The total increase in population between 2000 and 2010
The projected population of the town 10 years after 2010
The average increase per year of the population between 2000 and 2010
questions.explanation: The population grew by 26,753 − 26,252 = 501 over 10 years, so 10x is the total increase and x is the average increase per year.

questions.question: A circle has a radius of 19 meters. What is the area, in square meters, of the circle?

In triangle FGH and triangle KLM, the measures of angles G and L are each 30°. The lengths of GH and LM are each 34 centimeters, and GH/GF = LM/LK. Which additional piece of information would be necessary to prove that triangle FGH is congruent to triangle KLM?
options: The lengths of FG and KM are each 17 centimeters.
The measures of angles H and M are each 60°.
The measures of angles F and K are each 90°.
questions.explanation: Since GH = LM, the ratio gives GF = LK. Two sides and the included angle are equal (SAS), so the triangles are congruent.
